description: Starting from a site page (Start walking route) never shows the route-type choice; navigation silently uses the last type (Normal by default), so Minzi cannot pick Accessible on her main path
refinement: R1-6 route type picker on the navigation-mode screen

description: Standard map navigation has no arrival state (AR navigation does), so map users never reach the site's audio or AR content from navigation
refinement: R1-2 shared arrival sheet + Simulate arrival in both modes

description: Weather page is a dead end: the advice says 'choose the Accessible route' but offers no way to act on it
refinement: R1-3 'Plan an accessible walk' button (preselects Accessible)

description: No way to enlarge text or raise contrast (A1 NFR1 'adjustable font size / high contrast' never implemented); secondary text is 5.1:1 — AA, but hard for low vision
refinement: R1-1 Language & display sheet: Larger text + High contrast

description: Printable map has route steps but no content about the places, so a teacher must research facts separately for a hand-out
refinement: R1-4 'At each stop' facts numbered like the map pins

description: While real routes load, the route cards show rough factor estimates that contradict the final times (Cascade: Accessible 68 min, Steep 25 min — 'faster' than Normal 39 min) and then jump
refinement: R1-8 cards show '…' while 'Checking slopes…'; estimates kept only for the no-network fallback

description: <li> elements inside role=radiogroup lose list semantics (axe: listitem, serious, 5 nodes)
refinement: Sheet rebuilt: switches in a list; languages as a radiogroup of buttons

description: Horizontally scrolling forecast (and the page, which had no focusable content) cannot be scrolled with a keyboard (axe: scrollable-region-focusable, serious)
refinement: Forecast strip focusable with a label; page now contains a button

description: Forecast conditions exist only as aria-hidden emoji and the comfort chart bars have no text: screen-reader users cannot tell which day is rainy
refinement: Visually hidden condition per day + hour-by-hour score list

description: Google Maps attribution links ('Map Data', 'Terms') in the AR mini map are smaller than 24×24 px (axe: target-size, serious)
refinement: Third-party attribution required by Google's terms; mini map itself links to the full map

description: Map browse panel could only be hidden by dragging (added for the drag-to-dismiss request) — no single-pointer or keyboard alternative
refinement: Grip is now a 'Hide panel' button (tap or keyboard)

description: AR info bubbles can be repositioned only by dragging (optional feature; bubbles stay tappable)
refinement: Round 2 candidate: 'Reset layout' button or accept as non-essential

description: '9:41' in the simulated phone status bar over the hero photo flagged for contrast — decorative mock-up chrome (aria-hidden), not app content
refinement: False positive — documented

refinement: Hypothesis — verify in T8; possible fix: label list times 'about' or reuse route minutes once known

description: Icon-only map controls (speaker, 'wifi' for offline) are ambiguous; the offline toggle reports 'Map saved for offline use' although caching is simulated
refinement: Hypothesis — probe in debrief; possible fix: text labels / honest 'coming soon'

description: With 5 sites, the Top 5 carousel repeats exactly the list below it
refinement: Hypothesis — observe in T1

refinement: Hypothesis — observe incidentally

description: Stops can be added only before choosing a destination (browse panel) or during navigation; the selected-destination panel — where the time is shown — can only remove them
refinement: Hypothesis — verify in T6/T8; possible fix: 'Add a stop' in the selected panel (reuse WaypointSheet)

description: 'Change mode' is the burgundy primary button during navigation, although the main task is following the route
